en.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta Dates Officially Confirmed for August
en.summary: Get ready to drop back into the fight. Activision and Infinity Ward have locked in the dates for the highly anticipated Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta tests across all major platforms.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4** players eager to get their hands on the latest installment. Activision and Infinity Ward have officially announced the dates for the upcoming beta tests, giving fans across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox a chance to experience the action before the full release. This year's playtest schedule kicks off with early access for players who have pre-ordered on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. This exclusive window will run from August 21 to August 25, allowing dedicated fans to be the first to test out the new features and modes.

Following the early access period, the open beta will commence on August 28 and conclude on September 1. Notably, the Nintendo Switch 2 will also be included in the beta testing phase, marking a significant expansion of **Call of Duty**'s reach. The entire beta period is strategically timed to begin immediately after the **Call of Duty Next** presentation on August 21, which promises a deep dive into what's coming to **Modern Warfare 4**'s multiplayer, including live gameplay demonstrations and developer insights.

## Dive into the Action: What to Expect

While the full roster of weapons, Operators, and maps for the beta has yet to be revealed, Activision and Infinity Ward have provided a tantalizing glimpse of the content players can anticipate. The game is set to feature a robust multiplayer offering at launch, including 19 different weapons, intense 3v3 skirmishes, and the introduction of tanks. Players will be able to customize their loadouts and experiment with a wide selection of brand-new Operators. Those who pre-order the Vault Edition will gain access to all Vault Edition Operators, adding another layer of customization and exclusivity.

Modes will range from classic favorites like Search & Destroy to a brand-new mode called Kill Block. The developer has also promised a "Training Mobility Course," suggesting an emphasis on movement mechanics. This beta represents a crucial step in refining the game, allowing the developers to gather valuable feedback from the community. The chance to test out new modes and weapons, including the ability to unlock up to 19 different weapons before the official launch, makes this beta a must-play for any **Call of Duty** enthusiast.

## The Community's Anticipation

The confirmation of these beta dates has sent waves of excitement through the **Call of Duty** community. For years, fans have debated the direction of the **Modern Warfare** series, and the upcoming installment, **Modern Warfare 4**, is poised to address many of those discussions. The inclusion of the Nintendo Switch 2 in the beta is a particularly interesting development, hinting at a potentially more unified **Call of Duty** experience across platforms. Players are eager to see how the new Operators, weapons, and modes will shake up the established multiplayer meta. The promise of tanks and large-scale tactical battles alongside smaller, more intimate skirmishes suggests a diverse and engaging multiplayer landscape.

## What's Next

With the beta scheduled to begin on August 21 and the open beta concluding on September 1, players have a limited but crucial window to influence the final game. The official launch of **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4** is set for October 23, 2026, with campaign early access starting October 16 for digital pre-orders. This beta phase is the final major opportunity for players to get a taste of the action and provide essential feedback before the game arrives in full.

content_raw: Activision and Infinity Ward have confirmed dates for the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta tests across PC, Nintendo, PlayStation, and Xbox devices. The team behind this year's first-person shooter installment revealed its playtest plans with a blog post on their website . Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players who pre-ordered on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X | S can dive in first when beta early access runs from August 21 – 25, with Nintendo Switch 2 joining the mix when the open beta takes place between August 28 – September 1. It's all set to truly kick off immediately after the Call of Duty Next presentation comes to an end August 21. A brief description for this year's event promises "live gameplay, an in-depth briefing on the lineup of content coming to Modern Warfare 4's Multiplayer, developer insights, and new reveals ahead of the beta." Exactly which weapons, Operators, maps, and modes will be featured in the beta have yet to be revealed, but Activision and Infinity Ward did give players a taste of what's to come. Of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's launch content, the post promises 19 different weapons, 3v3 skirmishes, tanks, Kill Block, and more. "Get ready to drop into multiple Multiplayer maps and modes," the post said, "choosing from a wide selection of brand-new Operators, including all the Vault Edition Operators for players who pre-order the Vault Edition, and unlocking as many as 19 different weapons before deploying into everything from small-scale 3v3 skirmishes to massive tactical battles featuring tanks and more. Test your mettle across new and returning modes, from Search & Destroy to the brand-new Kill Block, plus the Training Mobility Course." The post added that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta players will be able to build loadouts with the new Gunny system . More information on the upcoming tests will be revealed "soon." Elsewhere in the post is confirmation for what the Vault Edition unlocks during the beta, with pre-order purchasers able to use Operators Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix, for example. Meanwhile, Switch 2 users can now officially look forward to locking in their pre-order starting August 26 as Call of Duty returns to Nintendo platforms for the first time in years. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches for PC, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X | S October 23, 2026.
